g.text: Is the system flat? Each planet's orbital plane fitted on its own

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #898781

g.text: Coloured: posterior density of each planet's plane in the Unconstrained fit. Grey dots: the single plane of the Coplanar fit. Where the colour overlaps the grey, one flat system fits that planet too.
